what: The SWD/JTAG clock pyOCD runs at when neither its command line nor a configuration file sets one, recorded so a remediation step that offers a slower clock is held to the clock the flash already ran at and not to what somebody remembered of it (#516). The pyOCD backend passes the probe and the target type to `pyocd flash` and no clock of its own, so a flash through it runs at this default. `pyocd flash --help` documents the grammar `--frequency` accepts and names no default for it; `json --features` lists every option pyOCD knows with its default. The run touched no probe: it prints and exits.
how: pyOCD 0.45.1 as the container test image installs it (tools/container/Dockerfile, python:3.12-slim, the version held in requirements/container.in), no probe attached. The run printed a JSON document of 25794 bytes on stdout, 1 feature and 84 options, and nothing on stderr. Kept here are the document's version fields and the one option the test reads, `frequency`, as pyOCD printed them; the other options and the feature are left out.
